# The Glorious Alliance — Narrative Script

*Audio: 01_Glorious_Alliance.mp3 — July 22, 2026*

---

Built one million two hundred thousand years ago, the Glorious Alliance was a massive arcology ship carrying twenty million people. Captain Mad-Dog, secretly a Hybrian Shadow, sabotaged the ship.

A twelve-year-old girl named Xiumi crawled through the ventilation system for eight days, visited by the Hope Goddess, and pressed a button that saved the last free populations of five species. Her soul split into three. One fragment became Nethra.

The ship emerged around fifteen thousand BGD and crashed into Ge'or, destroying a moon and creating the Silver Bride ring. Eight million died. Four million escaped. The survivors forgot everything.

Age One began.
